# Worksheet dev-a0a2f1

## Facts from the documents
- Policy AS/2026/661794/75, individual, SI 3,00,000, CB 0, period 01/06/2026-31/05/2027, continuous since 01/06/2022.
- Admission 14/09/2026, discharge 18/09/2026 = 4 days = ICU 1 + room 3 (consistent). Lap cholecystectomy for cholelithiasis.
- Room 3 x 8,000; ICU 1 x 12,000. Bill total 124,210; other bill 04/09 USG 1,800; claimed 126,010.

## Eligibility checks
- Renewal with continuous cover since 01/06/2022; admission 14/09/2026 lies within the policy period 01/06/2026-31/05/2027 (Clause 2). 30-day (6.2), 24/48-month (6.3) and PED (6.1) waiting periods: gall bladder calculi 24-month wait (6.3 i.18) completed (>4 years).

## Limits (Clause 4.1(i), 4.1(ii))
- Room rent cap = min(2% x SI 300,000.00, 5,000) = 5,000.00 per day
- ICU cap = min(5% x SI 300,000.00, 10,000) = 10,000.00 per day
- Sum insured used for these % limits is the base SI in the schedule (Clause 3.47 defines SI separately from Cumulative Bonus).

## Proportionate deduction ratio (Clause 4.1 Note 2; DECISIONS #1, #2)
- ICU rate 12,000.00 > cap 10,000.00 -> ratio 10,000.00/12,000.00 = 0.833333
- ROOM rate 8,000.00 > cap 5,000.00 -> ratio 5,000.00/8,000.00 = 0.625000
- Ratio applied to all other hospital charges except medicines = lowest ratio = 0.625000

## Bill lines
| # | Item | Billed | Treatment | Clause | Admissible before proportion |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---:|
| 1 | Surgical ICU - room rent | 12,000.00 | ICU 1 d x 12,000.00 ; cap 10,000.00 /day -> eligible 10,000.00 (excess 2,000.00) | 4.1(ii) | 10,000.00 |
| 2 | Single private AC - room rent | 24,000.00 | Room 3 d x 8,000.00 ; cap 5,000.00 /day -> eligible 15,000.00 (excess 9,000.00) | 4.1(i) | 15,000.00 |
| 3 | Surgeon charges - Lap. cholecystectomy | 36,800.00 | Payable; subject to proportion | 4.1(iii)/(iv) | 36,800.00 |
| 4 | Anaesthesia charges | 10,650.00 | Payable; subject to proportion | 4.1(iii)/(iv) | 10,650.00 |
| 5 | Physician visit charges | 3,900.00 | Payable; subject to proportion | 4.1(iii)/(iv) | 3,900.00 |
| 6 | Operation theatre rent | 13,850.00 | Payable; subject to proportion | 4.1(iii)/(iv) | 13,850.00 |
| 7 | Laboratory & radiology | 6,300.00 | Payable; subject to proportion | 4.1(iii)/(iv) | 6,300.00 |
| 8 | Drugs & IV fluids | 8,900.00 | Payable; medicines exempt from proportion | 4.1(iv); 4.1 Note 2 | 8,900.00 |
| 9 | Surgical consumables | 6,450.00 | Payable; subject to proportion | 4.1(iii)/(iv) | 6,450.00 |
| 10 | Gloves and masks | 750.00 | Not payable: List I items 56 (gloves), 60 (mask) | 4.7, Annexure A | 0.00 |
| 11 | Mineral water | 160.00 | Not payable: List I item 12 | 4.7, Annexure A | 0.00 |
| 12 | Admission kit | 450.00 | Not payable: List II item 27 - subsumed into room charges | 4.7, Annexure A | 0.00 |
| 13 | 04/09/2026 Ultrasound abdomen - other bill | 1,800.00 | Pre-hospitalisation, 10 days before admission, same condition - payable; not proportioned (not incurred at the hospital) | 4.4 / 3.36 | 1,800.00 |
| | **Total billed/claimed** | **126,010.00** | | | **113,650.00** |

- Check: hospital lines sum to 124,210.00 vs bill grand total 124,210.00 -> agree
- Total claimed (hospital + other bills) = 126,010.00

## Step results
1. Room/ICU excess over caps (4.1(i)/(ii)): 11,000.00
2. Non-payable / subsumed items (4.7, Annexure A; 4.1.1(v); 4.5): 1,360.00
3. Proportionate deduction (4.1 Note 2): base (non-medicine hospital charges other than room/ICU) 77,950.00 x (1 - 0.625000) = 29,231.25 -> rounded 29,231
4. Admissible before sub-limit/co-pay = 84,419.00
5. Sub-limits: none applicable
6. Co-payment 5% (Clause 9.3; DECISIONS #3, on admissible after all deductions/sub-limits): 84,419.00 x 5% = 4,220.95 -> 4,221
7. Net after co-pay = 80,198.00
8. Sum insured + CB this policy year = 300,000.00; earlier claims paid 0.00 / admitted 0.00 -> available 300,000.00 (by paid) / 300,000.00 (by admitted) (Clause 2, 3.47, DECISIONS #4)
9. **Payable = 80,198**

## Comparison with the settlement letter
| Letter deduction | Amount | Verdict | Correct amount | Why |
|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| Less: Room / ICU rent above eligible limit | 11,000 | matches | 11,000 | Room 3 x (8,000 - 5,000) = 9,000 + ICU 2,000 (Clause 4.1(i)/(ii)). |
| Less: Gloves and masks - List I (not payable) | 750 | matches | 750 | List I items 56, 60. |
| Less: Mineral water - List I (not payable) | 160 | matches | 160 | List I item 12. |
| Less: Admission kit - List II (part of room charges) | 450 | matches | 450 | List II item 27. |
| Less: Proportionate deduction (room category above eligibility) | 38,975 | disputable | 29,231 | Ratio should be 5,000/8,000 = 0.625 (lower of room 0.625 and ICU 0.833): 77,950 x 0.375 = 29,231; insurer used a 50% cut (77,950 x 0.5). |
| Less: Co-payment 5% | 3,734 | consequential | 4,221 | Method right; base reduced by the wrong proportionate cut. 5% of 84,419. |

- Insurer paid: 70,941 ; gold payable: 80,198 ; difference (payable - paid): 9,257
- Overall: **disputable**

## Notes
Both room and ICU exceed caps; per DECISIONS #2 the lower ratio is applied. Drugs & IV fluids treated as medicines (exempt); consumables, implants, diagnostics are proportioned (DECISIONS #1). Pre-hospitalisation bill not proportioned (Note 2 covers expenses "incurred at the Hospital"). The insurer's 38,975 equals exactly 50% of the non-medicine charges; no ratio in the documents gives 0.5.
